newsitem.title: FINLAND: SANTASALO TO BUY ASKO UNIT FOR FIM 240 MLN.
newsitem.headline: SANTASALO TO BUY ASKO UNIT FOR FIM 240 MLN.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Santasalo-JOT Oy said on Thursday it would buy Asko Oy's cast component operations for about 240 million markka.

"According to a letter of intent, Santasalo-JOT will buy operations of Asko Components Oy, Wirsbo Smide AB and Prometek AB from Asko for about 240 million markka," Santasalo said in a statement, adding that at the same time it would issue 400,000 new shares to Asko at a 50 markka price per share.
Santasalo-JOT said it would also issue 600,000 new shares in another share issue, terms of which would be announced later, to finance the deal.
Santasalo-JOT said it sees significant synergy benefits from the deal, which is expected to raise the group's annual net sales to 1.3 billion markka from 846 million markka in 1996.
"The target of the deal is to form Scandinavia's biggest cast component group," it said.
The deal is due to be completed by February 28, 1997.
